title: seqeralabs/nf-raffle pipeline parameters
description: Enter event raffles at Seqera-sponsored conferences

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Who you are and which event raffle to enter.

email.help_text: The email address the raffle organizers will use to contact the winner.
email.errorMessage: Please provide a valid email address with --email

event.help_text: Each value corresponds to event_configs/<event>.json. Some events also require --first_name, --last_name and --affiliation.

first_name.description: Your first name. Required for events that request it (e.g. ASHG 2026).

last_name.description: Your last name. Required for events that request it (e.g. ASHG 2026).

affiliation.description: Your company or institution name (organization). Required for events that request it (e.g. ASHG 2026).

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options, mostly for testing.

ticket_number_emit_session_id.description: Use the session ID instead of the run name as the ticket number.

event_config.description: Test only: path to an event config JSON that replaces event_configs/<event>.json.
event_config.help_text: Used by the `test` profile to post to a local mock form. Do not point this at a real event form.
